attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his Substack post. He lists this as one of his predictions that has come true and presents it as current fact.

semantics.note: The claim describes the state of things as of October 2025 and is unhedged. The drafter's addition of 'LLM' to 'hallucinations' matches the context of the post.

contract.note: The plain reading (no method reliably eliminates hallucinations in leading models) is the ordinary meaning of 'no robust solution'. Using the period just before the post is reasonable. Lower hallucination rates do not count as a solution under this reading.

evidence.note: OpenAI post dated 5 Sep 2025, inside the target period. The developer says GPT-5 still hallucinates and calls hallucinations a fundamental challenge for all LLMs. This is a company disclosure, but an admission that cuts against its own interest.
Same OpenAI post. It calls hallucinations stubbornly hard to fully solve, which shows no robust solution existed as of September 2025.

reviews.rationale: Leading developer OpenAI said in September 2025 that hallucinations still occur in GPT-5 and remain a fundamental, unsolved challenge for all LLMs. That meets the support condition. Lower rates are progress, not a robust solution, and the packet shows no method that reliably eliminates hallucinations, so nothing meets the contradiction condition.
